mass_influence.description: Support for the Bolsheviks among workers, soldiers, and (more thinly) peasants in Petrograd and beyond - public standing, not internal party standing.

party_standing.description: Trotsky's standing within the Bolshevik party and Central Committee specifically - high means the party follows his lead on contested tactical questions.

soviet_authority.description: Institutional authority as Chairman of the Petrograd Soviet, independent of party standing.

state_legitimacy.description: Standing with/recognition from the Provisional Government's own institutions - low by design, since the character is in opposition to them.

left_sr_alliance.description: Working relationship with the Left Socialist-Revolutionaries, the most plausible coalition partner for an insurrection.

menshevik_internationalist_alignment.description: Overlap/goodwill with the Menshevik-Internationalist wing specifically (distinct from the Menshevik party as a whole).

lenins_trust.description: Lenin's confidence in Trotsky specifically - distinct from the general relationships.lenin trust score, this is the mechanically load-bearing number for whether Lenin backs Trotsky's calls on contested tactics.

mrc_authority.description: Authority within/over the Military-Revolutionary Committee. Starts near zero because the MRC doesn't exist yet at campaign start - it's formed in October.

garrison_loyalty.description: How reliably the Petrograd garrison would act on the Soviet's orders over the Provisional Government's.

international_reputation.description: Standing among foreign socialist movements and governments - low for now, since the character is still primarily a domestic figure at campaign start.

personal_safety.description: How safe the character actually is from arrest, violence, or assassination right now. High = safe. Hitting the bottom band (Suspect/Negative) should make arrest or assassination an active, GM-flagged threat, not just flavor text.

notes: per_check_max_delta bounds how much any single check's resource delta is allowed to move a category, regardless of what the model proposes. Categories are numeric 0-100 under the hood; see systems/_shared/core.py RESOURCE_LABELS for the display-label thresholds (Dominant/High/Rising-New/Moderate/Low/Suspect-Negative).
